title: MoveFurniture Command
description: Move or turn one piece of furniture: to puts its centre at [x, y], by moves it [dx, dy], rotate turns it about its centre (degrees, counter-clockwise). It must stay inside a room and clear of other pieces, else it is refused with the reason. forsk:room follows it. The piece is the id, else the picked one, else the only one.

id.description: The piece's GUID or its forsk:id (F01).

rotate.description: Turn about the centre, degrees counter-clockwise.
